products.heading: Products
products.empty: No products yet. Create a product to start tracking inventory.

archiveConfirm.title: Archive this product?
archiveConfirm.body: ‘{{name}}’ will be archived. It can no longer be sold or picked when recording new sales. Its past sales and stock history stay intact, and it stays visible under “Show archived products”. This can't be undone.

productDialog.name: Name
productDialog.movingAverageHelp: Moving average — updated automatically by purchases
productDialog.revenueAccountHelp: Where this product's sales revenue is booked

noStock.title: No stock available
noStock.intro: You need stock in order to record a sale. To add stock for any of your products, follow these steps:
noStock.step2: Register a purchase under ‘Purchases’ and link it to your product(s). This recalculates the unit cost based on the purchase.
noStock.step3: Record a sale to calculate revenue.

void.title: Void this sale?
void.body: A reversing entry is posted to the ledger, undoing the recorded revenue and cost, and {{qty}} × {{name}} goes back in stock. Voiding is permanent.

shopify.title: Import orders from Shopify
shopify.notConnected: Shopify isn't connected yet. Add your API key and store domain in <settingsLink>Settings → Integrations</settingsLink> first.
shopify.paypalFeesPending: PayPal fee determined during bank reconciliation
shopify.mapIntro: Map every order component. Product mappings adjust stock; revenue mappings post directly to the selected account. Shopify Payments orders wait for fee details; PayPal orders are imported gross and their fee is recorded during bank reconciliation.

errors.appNotInstalled: This app isn't installed on your Shopify store yet. Open your Shopify admin and install the app, then try again.
errors.invalidClient: Shopify rejected your app credentials. Check the Client ID and app secret in Settings → Integrations.
errors.rateLimited: Shopify is rate-limiting requests. Please wait a moment and try again.

lineStatus.skipped_order_total_mismatch: Order components do not match the Shopify payment

orderSkip.skipped_legacy_partial_import: Partly imported by the former workflow

shopifyPayout.title: Record payment
shopifyPayout.recordPaymentIntro: Record Shopify Payments or PayPal deposits directly on the primary bank account when you do not import bank statements.
shopifyPayout.intro: Record a paid Shopify payout directly on the primary bank account when you do not import bank statements. Shopify fees are already included in the net payout.
shopifyPayout.customIntro: Create a local payout for imported orders whose payout is no longer available through Shopify. Select the order contributions included in the bank payment.
shopifyPayout.customEmpty: No unassigned Shopify order contributions are available.
shopifyPayout.empty: No unsettled paid Shopify payouts found. Refresh a date range to check Shopify.
shopifyPayout.adjustmentsIntro: Categorize each non-order adjustment before recording this payout.
shopifyPayout.incomplete: This payout is not ready because its balance transactions are incomplete.
shopifyPayout.recorded: Payment recorded on the primary bank account.

paypal.title: Custom PayPal payment
paypal.intro: Select the outstanding PayPal orders included in this bank deposit. Any difference is booked as a fee or adjustment.

errors.load: Shopify payouts could not be loaded.
errors.refresh: Shopify payouts could not be refreshed.
errors.create: The custom Shopify payout could not be created.
errors.createPaypal: The custom PayPal payment could not be recorded.
errors.settle: The Shopify payout could not be recorded.
